articles.title: Google-Kalender freigeben: den tatsächlichen Zugriff prüfen
articles.description: Wähle Zugriff auf Verfügbarkeit, Details oder Bearbeitung. Prüfe vor dem Teilen auch öffentliche und Gruppenfreigaben, nicht nur einzelne Personen.

articles.title: Kalenderantworten: Teilnahme und Freigabezugriff unterscheiden
articles.description: Unterscheide Teilnahmeantworten von offenen Einladungen, anonymen Empfängern und angenommenen Freigaben. Bestätige Teilnahme ohne geschätzte Gästezahlen.

articles.title: Share one calendar event: choose the link and access you mean
articles.description: Share one event without sharing a whole calendar. Understand Reader, Writer and Owner access, preview links, updates and the limits of revocation.

articles.title: Sharing an event with someone who does not have Cloud Calendars
articles.description: Understand event previews, App Clips, full-app imports and ICS subscriptions before sending an invitation to someone who does not use Cloud Calendars.

articles.title: Share a calendar with the right people and permissions
articles.description: Choose a separate calendar, distinguish app sharing from provider sharing, and assign Reader, Writer or Owner access without promising instant updates.

articles.title: Google Calendar sharing permissions: check the access you actually grant
articles.description: Choose Google Calendar access for availability, details or editing. Check public and group access as well as individual permissions before sharing.

articles.title: Calendar replies: separate attendance from sharing access
articles.description: Distinguish guest RSVPs from pending invitations, anonymous recipients and shared-calendar acceptance. Confirm attendance without inventing a headcount.

articles.title: Google Meet and Microsoft Teams links: create, save and check
articles.description: See which calendars can create Meet or Teams links, how the plans differ and what to check when a saved event has no working joining link.

articles.title: Permisos de Google Calendar: revisa el acceso que realmente concedes
articles.description: Elige acceso a disponibilidad, detalles o edición. Revisa los permisos públicos y de grupos, además de los individuales, antes de compartir.

articles.title: Respuestas del calendario: distingue asistencia y acceso compartido
articles.description: Distingue respuestas de asistencia, invitaciones pendientes, destinatarios anónimos y acceso aceptado. Confirma asistentes sin inventar cifras.

articles.title: Autorisations Google Agenda : vérifiez l’accès réellement accordé
articles.description: Choisissez un accès aux disponibilités, aux détails ou à la modification. Vérifiez aussi les accès publics et par groupe avant de partager.

articles.title: Réponses aux invitations : distinguer présence et accès partagé
articles.description: Distinguez réponses de présence, invitations en attente, destinataires anonymes et partage accepté. Confirmez les présences sans inventer de total.

articles.title: Permessi di Google Calendar: controlla l’accesso effettivamente concesso
articles.description: Scegli accesso a disponibilità, dettagli o modifica. Prima di condividere controlla anche accessi pubblici e di gruppo, oltre a quelli individuali.

articles.title: Risposte agli inviti: distinguere partecipazione e accesso condiviso
articles.description: Distingui risposte di partecipazione, inviti in attesa, destinatari anonimi e accessi accettati. Conferma le presenze senza inventare un totale.
